name: Samskara Brain Bridge
description: Connects Orca to the Samskara brain (https://samskara-mind.replit.app). Adds Buddhi reasoning, Chitta memory, Viveka safety checks, and karma feedback to every agent response.

apiKey.description: Samskara tenant API key (X-API-Key). Set via SAMSKARA_API_KEY env var.

agentId.description: Registered agent ID in Samskara. Default: orca-v1

baseUrl.description: Samskara server base URL. Override for private deployments.

enforceSafety.description: Block tool execution when Samskara safety check returns allowed:false.

injectConsultContext.description: Prepend Buddhi analysis to LLM system prompt on every response.

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum Buddhi confidence (0-1) to treat analysis as authoritative.

apiKey.label: Samskara API Key
apiKey.helpText: Your Samskara tenant key — starts with sk_

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.helpText: The agent ID registered in Samskara. See samskara-mind.replit.app

enforceSafety.label: Enforce Safety Gate
enforceSafety.helpText: When enabled, tool calls blocked by Samskara's Viveka layer will not execute.
